title: Unit 1 consolidation: the Americas before 1492
goal: I can talk about the first peoples, the great civilisations and how we know about them.
grammar: Review: past perfect, se passive, relative clauses, soler, reporting

items: Talk about the first peoples, the great civilisations and how we know about them.
Use the past perfect to say what had happened before 1492.
Describe how things were built and used with se + verb.
Say what people used to do and add information with que.
Report what experts say with según and indican que.
